EuroDigital — Victoria & Vancouver Island, BC (Canada)

EuroDigital designs and launches professional websites for Victoria and Vancouver Island service businesses, makers, and small shops — clear scope, practical Google setup, strong customer paths, and a handoff you own. Not a large agency, software firm, or monthly marketing retainer.

Core offer:
- Small business website launches and working online stores
- Small Website Repairs for narrowly scoped fixes on existing sites
- Includes (package-dependent): mobile-first design, contact or store flows, Analytics + Search Console, Google Business Profile support when it fits, basic SEO structure, domain/hosting setup, and a clear ownership handoff

Most likely project types:
1. Local service business websites (trades, contractors, landscapers, etc.) — example: MaestrosServices
2. Creative brand or maker websites (showcase + inquiries) — example: AnglKissCreations
3. Working online stores (catalog, cart, checkout, payments) — example: StarMapCo

Published starting prices (CAD; written scope before work starts):
- Small Website Repairs — from $125 (existing-site fixes only; not a new-site price)
- One-Page Launch — from $499
- Business Website — from $1,250 (recommended for most established local businesses)
- Online Store — from $2,000
- Custom Project — quoted per project

Service area:
- Victoria, Vancouver Island, British Columbia, Canada
- Remote-friendly projects may be considered when the fit is clear
